Question: Two right circular cylinders have the same volume. The radius of the second cylinder is \(10\%\) more than the radius of the first. What is the relationship between the heights of the two cylinders?

Choices.A: The second height is \(10\%\) less than the first.
Choices.B: The first height is \(10\%\) more than the second.
Choices.C: The second height is \(21\%\) less than the first.
Choices.D:
The first height is \(21\%\) more than the
second.
Choices.E: The second height is \(80\%\) of the first.
